additional_searches.method: walk and SHA-256 every Fortran source-extension candidate, including arbitrary basenames
walk and SHA-256 likely named source backup/text candidates in a source-sized range
list archive members and hash uncompressed members whose path contains lapsprep.f90
inspect manifests and build/copy references around upstream LAPSPREP builds
observations: Pinned input manifest exists at Cloud-BAL/scratch/upstream_lapsprep_build.HjBepF/inputs.sha256, but source file is absent from that build tree.
Source references found in build scripts/manifests did not expose a retained source backup whose bytes match the target digest.

source_copy_and_debug_note: The 108 archive scan was bounded to member paths containing lapsprep.f90. No matching source-named archive member was present. No attempt was made to infer source bytes from object/executable debug sections; debug metadata can identify source paths/lines but is not itself the source file.
limitations: Roots are limited to Cloud-BAL/scratch and klaps-v5.0_; no unrestricted filesystem sweep.
The archive-member check filters member names containing lapsprep.f90 and would miss a renamed source inside an archive.

The backup-extension pass is bounded by the listed suffixes and file size; arbitrarily renamed copies with unrelated suffixes or source hidden in archives under unrelated member names can remain undiscovered.
Prior exact-basename search found 61 candidates; this pass adds 43,986 Fortran-source files and 559 named backup/text candidates, with possible overlap between passes.
This negative result does not establish that the source never existed or that the pinned executable was built from the current maintained source.

reproduction.fortran_hash_scan: Python os.walk over both roots; SHA-256 each regular file with the listed Fortran suffixes; target digest compared byte-for-byte.
reproduction.backup_scan: Python os.walk over both roots; listed backup/text filename suffixes and inclusive 15,000–180,000 byte size bound; SHA-256 each candidate.
reproduction.archive_scan: Python tarfile/zipfile walks 108 tar/zip archives; hashes uncompressed regular members with member path containing lapsprep.f90.
